init_BLINK_retriever: initialize a BLINK retriever instance with config args and load dense retrieval models
feed_data_BLINK: feed query data into the BLINK retriever to extract entity mentions using NER
run_BLINK_retriever: run the BLINK retriever to get Wikipedia entity predictions and provenance scores
review_BLINK_feed_data: review the BLINK feed_data method that parses entity tokens and applies NER tagging
refactor_BLINK_run: refactor the BLINK run method to aggregate predictions and map titles to Wikipedia IDs
